home.emptyInstalled: Nothing installed yet. Open the library to add a program.
home.welcome: A store for programs that stay themselves.
home.welcomeBody: Developers write in the language they already know. You install from GitHub, with a contract no thicker than a manifest.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: Public GitHub repositories tagged muck-store.
discover.empty: No repositories found. Publish with topic muck-store, or paste a repo URL.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Official programs reviewed and shipped with Muck Store.

trust.title: Approve this program
trust.body: Muck Store checked the GitHub source, license, manifest and hashes. It does not audit the author's intent. Community programs can still harm this PC — approve only if you trust this repository.
trust.verifiedBody: This program is in the official catalog. Muck Store verified its manifest, license and bundled files. Authenticode / SmartScreen is not required.
trust.blockedHint: Verification failed. This program will not be installed.
trust.av: Windows Defender may still scan the files. Muck Store does not turn Defender off. After you approve, the download mark is cleared so SmartScreen is not the install prompt — our checklist is.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Catalog programs update here. The store itself updates in a small window before it opens.

themes.title: Themes
themes.subtitle: Color systems for the store chrome. Programs keep their own UI.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Layout, startup, trust and the paths Muck Store uses on this PC.
settings.appearanceHint: These tokens apply to the store chrome only.
settings.languageHint: Menus and store copy. Programs can ship their own strings.
settings.micaHint: Soft blur on chrome. Turn off if you prefer a solid panel.
settings.reducedMotionHint: Cuts transitions if they feel noisy.
settings.fontScaleHint: Scales the store interface, not installed programs.
settings.startupHint: Sign-in opens the updater first. If nothing is new, the store follows.
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Windows starts the updater, then the store.
settings.libraryHint: Programs, cache and themes live outside the install folder.
settings.updatesHint: The store updater is a separate exe. Catalog programs update inside this window.
settings.autoStoreHint: When a newer installer is on GitHub, the updater applies it before opening the store.
settings.telemetryOff: Off by default and staying off unless you enable it.
settings.approvalsHint: Programs you approved after verification. A new version or commit needs a fresh approval. No code-signing certificate is required.
settings.defender: Add Defender exclusion for the programs folder
settings.defenderHint: Never applied silently. Requires your consent and a UAC prompt.
settings.isolation: Job Object isolation for started programs
settings.isolationHint: Recorded for a later Windows Job Object pass. Starting a program no longer freezes the store.

programSettings.title: Program settings
programSettings.none: This program exposes no managed settings.

boot.hint: Catalog and settings load from this PC. Store updates run in the updater before this window opens.
